summary: The protected health endpoint the review checked for now really exists: visiting /api/health returns a small, consistent status answer ("ok", service name, no run or account data) for anyone — no login needed, no more ambiguous "API route not found". The deployment is verified live on the server itself and on the public platform URL (https://prod-qase-2-1-tawpkk.drytis.dev/api/health); on qase.drytis.com the page-level 502 is a separate, already-documented platform routing problem (edge has no route row: custom-domain registration returns empty).
what_was_done: Added the /api/health status endpoint (commit ed0d372) — answers with a clear, consistent status message instead of "API route not found"
The endpoint works without signing in, so health checks from any tool get a reliable answer
Added automated tests so the endpoint can never silently disappear again
Deployed to production and brought the pod fully current (dc66ab0), confirmed running and serving the new code
Restored the public platform-URL proxy path so the endpoint is verifiable from outside the cluster while customer-domain edge routing is pending platform-side registration
what_was_tested: Visited /api/health with no login: returns status "ok" with the service name and a request ID
Visited a made-up /api/... address with no session: correctly still gated (401 Authentication required)
Full automated test suite: 505 tests, 0 failures
Confirmed the production server is running exactly the deployed code (commit dc66ab0) and serves the endpoint on the pod

test_results.name: GET /api/health without login returns 200 with status payload
Production running new code and serving the endpoint
test_results.note: Pod serves it on localhost:5173; reachable publicly at https://prod-qase-2-1-tawpkk.drytis.dev/api/health

test_results.name: qase.drytis.com serves the app pages directly
test_results.note: Domain / and /api/health still return the edge 502 — platform-side custom-domain routing (custom_domains returns []), tracked on this ticket with full evidence; /health returns 200 via the domain and the same pages load fine via the platform URL

notes: The engineer's observation is fully addressed: /api/health now exists, is mounted before the login gate, and answers deterministically

The page-level 502 on the domain is a platform routing issue (custom-domain registration returns empty under every flow), not application code — evidence trail is on this ticket; the app pages load fine via the platform URL
Reproduced and worked around the known boot-time quirk: the pod occasionally boots on the previous commit; fetching and fast-forwarding, then restarting the app, is the documented recovery
Verification path for re-review: https://prod-qase-2-1-tawpkk.drytis.dev/api/health (public) or the domain once platform routing is registered
review_checklist: Visit https://prod-qase-2-1-tawpkk.drytis.dev/api/health (or https://qase.drytis.com/api/health if the domain edge route is registered by then) and confirm you see the "ok" status answer without logging in
Visit /api/definitely-not-a-route without a session and confirm it is still gated (401), i.e. the new endpoint does not open up the rest of the API
